additional_info.subject: RE: ID0450794-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T4170004764] Power converter issue CRM:02889000644
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0450794
. The ticket has been opened for E17 on a power converter of charger
RVP/T4 170004764.
I analyzed the charger and these are my findings:
E17 is generated by a CAN communication interruption between the PLC and the Power Converter
The E17 is present on the Power converter with SN
2102313PAVKXPA000562
since this morning (19.09.2025).
A reboot did not re-establish the communication.
The Power converter belongs to the converter group of DC2. This means that the charger can perfectly work, but the Converter Group of DC2 is limited to only one power converter (40kW power available).
It can happen that this error is temporary and it clears out. Nevertheless, when this error appears and cannot be immediately cleared with a reboot (like this case),
it is recommended to replace the power converter.
Therefore, I am moving
the case
0450794
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT  SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
